statusDetail: Coverage-complete public-surface audit. Authenticated home, account settings, purchase/checkout, creation tools, native game launch completion, and destructive account flows were not covered because no test credentials or purchase authorization were supplied.

paths.description: Guest landing and signup archetype; primary acquisition journey and global consent surface.
Authentication form archetype; labels, autofill, focus, feedback and repeated-interaction memory test.
Public listing/index archetype representing discovery feeds and filter navigation.
Public experience detail archetype, media carousel and launch entry surface.
Arabic localized landing template for RTL and translation readiness.

findings.summary: Navigations do not preserve visual continuity.
findings.evidence: DOM and CSS captures across the home, charts, login, and game templates contain no view-transition-name, @view-transition, or View Transition API use.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions to same-origin MPA navigation, with reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: The media carousel exposes buttons but no native swipe or snap affordance.
findings.evidence: The game DOM contains Back/Next carousel controls, while captured CSS has no scroll-snap or overscroll-behavior rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the carousel as an overflow scroller with scroll-snap and retain accessible previous/next controls.

findings.summary: The cookie notice dominates and obscures the primary task on every public template.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots show the notice covering roughly the lower half of the signup, login, charts, and game surfaces; on 360px it occupies much of the first viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, content-first consent treatment where legally permitted, preserve equal Decline/Accept prominence, and avoid covering the primary form.

findings.summary: The blocking cookie notice is not exposed as a semantic dialog.
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM contains no <dialog>, role=dialog, or aria-modal element even though the cookie panel visually overlays and blocks underlying content.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a semantic dialog when interaction is modal, manage initial/return focus, and preserve the equally prominent Decline All action.

findings.summary: Signup is not a native form and depends entirely on JavaScript.
findings.evidence: The home DOM has signup inputs and a type=button submit control but no containing <form>; the no-JS crawler receives only 1% of rendered content.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap signup controls in a real form with an action/method or progressively enhanced submit handler, native submit button, labels, and server-side fallback.

findings.summary: The unauthenticated landing experience loads far too slowly.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 5.3s, LCP 23.3s, TBT 310ms and performance 0.50; the independent trace measured LCP 11.43s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, shorten the critical request chain, defer nonessential bundles, and schedule noncritical work after initial rendering.

findings.summary: Late rendering causes severe layout movement on key templates.
findings.evidence: The layout primitive observed CLS 0.327 on home, 0.321 on login, and 0.302 on the game detail page at 360px.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve space for delayed UI and images, render consent space predictably, and prevent late template injections from moving content.

findings.summary: The landing page ships an excessive critical network graph.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 211 requests and 4,761,272 transferred bytes, including 114 scripts (3,472,865 bytes) and 26 stylesheets; Lighthouse estimates 3,060ms render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Bundle by route, inline only critical CSS, defer noncritical styles/scripts, reduce parser-blocking dependencies, and validate resource priorities.

findings.summary: Most of the initial JavaScript and CSS is unused.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 1,526 KiB unused JavaScript and 118 KiB unused CSS; AngularJsUtilities alone wastes about 466 KiB while React bundles are also loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove legacy framework code from the route, split feature bundles, and load challenge, purchase, presence, and other feature code only on demand.

findings.summary: The landing page logs runtime and network errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured a realtime CORS failure, ERR_FAILED, and a 401 from rotating-client-service during a clean load.
findings.suggestedFix: Prevent guest-only requests that require authorization, fix CORS configuration, and handle expected failures without console errors.

findings.summary: Deprecated unload handling blocks the back/forward cache.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports an unload event listener in Sentry.js and two bfcache failure reasons, including UnloadHandlerExistsInMainFrame.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace unload with pagehide/visibilitychange where needed and remove the handler so navigation can use bfcache.

findings.summary: Important public listing content is invisible to non-JavaScript crawlers.
findings.evidence: Discoverability captures found only 1% raw-content coverage on home and 2% on Charts; Charts renders only a navigation shell and “Please enable Javascript” without JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render or statically render public landing and chart content, including useful links and headings, then hydrate interactions.

findings.summary: Several first-party cookies are sent without Secure and use SameSite=None.
findings.evidence: Cookie audit found 5 insecure cookies, including GuestData and RBXEventTrackerV2 without Secure and with 400-day lifetimes; the page is HTTPS.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark all HTTPS cookies Secure, use Lax or Strict unless cross-site use is essential, minimize retention, and keep sensitive cookies HttpOnly.

findings.summary: Browser security policy coverage is incomplete and CSP permits inline script.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found CSP with unsafe-inline, no X-Content-Type-Options, no Referrer-Policy, and no Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy nonce/hash-based CSP without unsafe-inline, add nosniff, a strict referrer policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The guest landing page has a broad third-party and telemetry footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence observed 16 non-main origins, PerimeterX endpoints, Sentry, metrics and heartbeat requests; HAR attributes 203 requests and 4.74MB to origins classified outside www.roblox.com, mostly Roblox CDNs plus external services.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit each guest-page request, delay optional telemetry until consent, consolidate origins, and remove data collection not required for signup.

findings.summary: Core public and signup content has no useful JavaScript-free baseline.
findings.evidence: No-JS captures show home and Charts as near-empty shells (1% and 2% raw coverage); signup has no native form submission path.
findings.suggestedFix: Render core content and native forms in server HTML, then enhance them without replacing the baseline.

findings.summary: Authentication autocomplete tokens are incomplete or invalid.
findings.evidence: Login username correctly uses “username webauthn”, but password has no autocomplete=current-password; signup username uses the nonstandard token signup-username.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=username for signup identity, new-password for signup password, and current-password for login password.

findings.summary: Several images lack sizing, lazy loading, and responsive delivery.
findings.evidence: Images audit found 9/9 without width and height, all 9 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, 8 without srcset, and two oversized store badges; Lighthouse separately estimated 206 KiB image savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, lazy-load below-fold images, provide responsive srcset/sizes, and convert/compress the oversized PNG asset.

findings.summary: The guest page starts background telemetry and excessive work before the core task is usable.
findings.evidence: HAR and tracker evidence include pageHeartbeat and analytics requests during initial load while 114 scripts are fetched and LCP remains delayed.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer analytics and heartbeat work until idle/consent, batch events, and stop nonessential background work when hidden.

findings.summary: The initial guest page exceeds a proportionate resource budget.
findings.evidence: The HAR records 4.76MB across 211 requests before signup, with 3.47MB of scripts and 0.79MB of images; Lighthouse total-byte-weight is only 0.50.
findings.suggestedFix: Set route-level budgets, cut initial script/image bytes, and hold optional third-party services outside the critical path.

findings.summary: The login route has a very large initial heap footprint.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 865,301 nodes, 3,604,843 edges, and 58,962,813 bytes self-size before a login attempt.
findings.suggestedFix: Load only login-critical modules, remove legacy/duplicate framework code, and profile constructor growth after bundle splitting.

taskList.title: Cut route-level JavaScript, CSS and critical request chains
Server-render public content and progressively enhance native forms
Eliminate late layout shifts across signup, login and detail templates
Harden cookies, CSP and browser policies
Reduce and defer guest telemetry and third-party work
Make consent compact and semantically modal
Remove console errors and unload handlers
Add navigation continuity and native carousel gestures
